text: Published completed61-state MRI checkpoint batch and bounded corrected-r24 inverse representation study. MRI fine refinement remains anatomically mixed: OASIS13 loses Dice while intensity improves; MMRR step-scaled gains Dice but worsensHD95. Inverse refinement reduces fixed/moving worst cycles to.194255/.206091mm at4x resolution with all roots/cells valid, but fails the unchanged two-arm0.2mm contract and costs~60x inverse nodes. No production edits or new full fits. D01/R02 and D02/P02/qualification gates remain open; next tasks retain remaining58-state accounting, isolated reference order, compact inverse representation and newly frozen candidate screen.
